title: A successful process with zero tests is mistaken for passing evidence
request: Fix evaluateRun({exit,tests}) in src/run-result.mjs. It returns pass only for exit 0 and a nonempty array of passed test records. Return fail for exit 1 with at least one failed record, provided all records have passed/failed status. Empty, missing or skipped populations, unsupported exits, and disagreement between exit and reported failures are inconclusive. Preserve the visible check.
seededFailure: The seed verifies exit/report consistency but lets an empty array establish a pass. A count-only shortcut rejects emptiness but still trusts process exit 0 when a reported test failed.
